name: Syria
description: Syria from Ebla and Ugarit to Damascus, the Umayyads, the crusades, the Ottomans, the French mandate, the Assads and the civil war.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Syria
checkpoints.note: Ebla and Ugarit flourished, and Damascus is among the oldest cities. Rome held Syria, and Zenobia ruled Palmyra.

checkpoints.name: Caliphs and crusaders
checkpoints.note: Damascus was capital of the Umayyads. Crusaders built castles, and Saladin and the Mamluks drove them out.

checkpoints.name: Ottomans and France
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans ruled for four centuries, then France.

checkpoints.name: Syria
checkpoints.note: Syria became independent in 1946. The Assads ruled from 1971 until 2024, and civil war tore the country.
